title: SourceForge Ticket
description: Schema for an issue or ticket in the SourceForge Allura tracker

ticket_num.description: Sequential ticket number within the project tracker

summary.description: Short title or summary of the ticket

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or feature request

status.description: Current status of the ticket (open, closed, pending, etc.)

assigned_to.description: Username of the person assigned to the ticket

labels.description: Tags or labels applied to the ticket

mod_date.description: When the ticket was last modified

private.description: Whether the ticket is private (visible to project members only)
